note: Very thin. Música típica (tonadas, cuecas: Los Cuatro Huasos, Los Huasos Quincheros, Ester Soré) and tango/Mexican/bolero imports dominated radio, but titles with verifiable recording years were scarce; Ester Soré's 1940s hits 'Morenito de mi alma', 'La yegüita', 'Chiquilla' exist but years are unverified.
